subject: Re: Status: repro validated post-VGG-fix, on-device gap
body:
Tereza, all — decisions from Friday's review.

The Jul 3 pre-read proposes shipping flare removal server-side in the imaging pipeline first: quality is there — with Rafael's 600-image lens-profile extension set, streak-flare cases improved visibly in this week's evals — and the on-device variant moves to Q4 as a distillation project with Yusuf's 3x latency gap stated plainly.

Scope cut: video flare removal is out entirely this cycle. Frame-consistency is unsolved and I won't hint at it in the review.

For the pre-read I need: the PSNR table against the released checkpoint, before/after panels on production-lens captures, and the on-device feasibility one-pager. Rafael's July evaluation round is the last gate before the board sees it.

Solid, honest quarter so far — keep it boring.

Lucia
